title: ApiResponseEnvelope
description: Standardized envelope schema for all JunctionIQ REST API responses

success.description: Indicates whether the API operation succeeded

timestamp.description: Server UTC timestamp of response emission

requestId.description: Unique UUID assigned to request lifecycle for observability

data.description: Payload body for successful queries or null on failure

error.description: Error diagnostic details if success is false

details.description: Granular field-level or parameter-level diagnostic messages
